title: Which club will sign Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig in summer 2026?
background: Yan Diomande is an Ivory Coast winger playing for RB Leipzig.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official announcement by RB Leipzig or the destination club confirming an agreement for Diomande's permanent transfer. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the destination club in the first such agreement announced between June 1 and August 31, 2026. Loan agreements do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The commonly used name of the destination club.
